definition: A grammar checker, in computing terms, is a program, or part of a program, that attempts to verify written text for grammatical correctness.
details: Grammar checkers are most often implemented as a feature of a larger program, such as a word processor, but are also available as a stand-alone application that can be activated from within programs that work with editable text. The implementation of a grammar checker makes use of natural language processing.
